title: Mirror Particle is building a model of changing human behavior
teaser: Mirror Particle is building a model of how human behavior changes over time, arguing that language models are the wrong tool for predicting what people will do. The two-year-old San Francisco startup is developing a foundation model from scratch and says it is close to closing its first venture round. Its pitch lands in a crowded field: Simile, Aaru and Humans& have all raised substantial sums for products focused on modeling people. What sets Mirror Particle’s approach apart is its emphasis on change—and on what people actually do, rather than what they say in surveys.
